manifest.reuse: Prior successful cluster witnesses reused. Prior unproven searches rerun only to collect missing bestPath diagnostics; original results immutable.

notes: Rates are solver witness rates, not true solvability or human win rates.
Success-only denominators are survivor-biased; use paired seeds to compare successful paths.
08 diagnostics cover saved best paths, not every state visited.
Reused witness runtimes are historical and are not timing benchmarks.
